name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
native_kbm_note: No source mentions keyboard/mouse support on PS5, and it is not on Push Square's PS5 mouse+keyboard games list. Mouse controls were advertised only for the Switch 2 version (nintendolife.com/news/2026/05/icymi-indiana-jones-on-switch-2-will-support-mouse-and-gyro-controls).
notes: There is no separate reload key: pressing shoot (LMB/R2) while not aiming reloads. Lean left/right is L3/R3 on PS5, shared with sprint (L3) and push (R3), so leaning probably only works in context (e.g. while crouched/aiming). Lean left is Z per Prima (MagicGameWorld lists Y). D-pad left/right: Prima says Weapon = Left and Inventory = Right, MagicGameWorld (Xbox) says the reverse; Prima is used because the PC alternates (Left arrow = Weapon, Right arrow = Inventory) match it. In menus, Q/E also act as previous/next tab (L1/R1 on PS5), which this mapping doesn't cover (Q = drop/Triangle, E = use/Square). Block secondary is LALT, journal secondary CAPSLOCK.
